fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of programs as Launch Agents or Launch Daemons using launchctl on macOS.
fields.name: Launch Agent/Daemon Execution Via Launchctl
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/launchctl" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "submit" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "load" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "start")))
